title: BeyondMimic: Compose Humanoid Skills with Guided State-Action Latent Diffusion
content_lines: Source: [arXiv:2508.08241v4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.08241v4). The public official repository covers the motion-tracking layer, not the complete CVAE/diffusion generator.

> **Bottom line:** BeyondMimic first creates executable closed-loop data with a scalable tracker, then learns diffusion over future states and latent actions. At test time, differentiable velocity, waypoint, keyframe, or SDF costs guide denoising without retraining the policy for each combination.
## Engineering problem
A tracker replays known motions but tasks specify partial outcomes. Retraining for every cost combination does not scale, while raw joint-action generation can leave the trackable motion manifold.
## Method

A minimal tracking MDP with adaptive sampling produces broad motion data. A conditional VAE compresses actions; a diffusion model predicts a 0.64 s state-latent-action horizon. Test-time cost gradients steer denoising, and receding-horizon feedback decodes only the current action.
## Key figures
![Figure 2: hardware tracking layer](../assets/beyondmimic-2508.08241v4/figure-2-hardware-tracking.jpg)
The selected 34 motions demonstrate tracker breadth but do not provide per-motion random-trial success denominators.
![Figures 5-6: command-conditioned behavior, transitions, and composition](../assets/beyondmimic-2508.08241v4/figure-5-6-guidance.jpg)

The selected command-conditioned behaviors and transitions show controllable composition, but not per-transition success denominators; the guidance mechanism still requires the paper's state-action diffusion evidence.
![Figure 8: representation, history, delay, and sampling](../assets/beyondmimic-2508.08241v4/figure-8-ablation.jpg)
The negative delay/history results show that the minimal low-latency tracker is an active design choice.
## Decisive evidence

Latent diffusion raises cross-MuJoCo cartwheel success from 5% to 95% in the reported ablation. Adaptive sampling rescues difficult clips, while 5–10 ms added delay can already break hardware transfer.
## Paper-to-implementation mapping

The official tracking code exposes motion errors/adaptive sampling, tracking rewards, events/terminations, and G1 PPO tasks. CVAE, diffusion, and guidance are not fully public and must be labeled independent reimplementations rather than inferred from the tracker repository.
## Limits and evidence boundary

A 0.64 s horizon is not global planning; state-estimation error enters generated plans, guidance weights remain task-specific, and composable costs may conflict or be infeasible. SDF guidance is not a formal collision guarantee.
## Bounded engineering takeaway

Treat guidance as short-horizon predictive control. Test conflicting/unreachable goals, estimator bias, switching, and latency, and provide a supervisor that can reject rather than indefinitely increase guidance.
## Reproduction checklist

Lock tracker data/commit, adaptive sampling, VAE, diffusion representation, horizon, costs, guidance scales, estimator, latency, and decoder. Compare raw/no-latent/action-latent/state-action models across motion clusters; report cost residuals, contact, failures, compute tails, and safety triggers.
